name: The Reckoning of the Sump: Gorgon-Prime Uncaged

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The subterranean floor has collapsed into a churning lake of boiling chemical sludge. A twenty-ton bio-titan rises from the abyss, shrieking in ultrasonic fury as caustic bile melts ferrocrete bulkheads like tallow.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Bio-Titanic Matriarch Eruption
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: The true Brood-Matriarch has surfaced in the Sump Charnel Ditches; 20 tons of adamantine chitin, scythe-limbs, and pressurized acid cannons.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Sustain heavy fire under lethal counter-attacks, crack the 70% damage reduction armor with heavy ordnance, or face complete slaughter of the garrison detachment.

active_combat_encounters.current_phase: Phase 1: Armor Breach & Heavy Ordnance Strike
active_combat_encounters.armor_status: Adamantine Layered Chitin (70% Damage Reduction against Las/Shotgun)
active_combat_encounters.tactical_requirements: Requires Heavy Stubber / Autocannon sustained suppression (min 2 belts) and targeted Krak charge / Power Fist assault to crack shell before vital organs can be damaged.
active_combat_encounters.failure_consequences: Lethal impalement to engaged officers, total annihilation of conscript detachments in the sector, loss of Sump trench sector.

decoy_larval_brood_pupa.name: Brood-Larval Decoy Pupa
decoy_larval_brood_pupa.threat_status: Blown to pieces by Krak Grenade
notable_kills: Decoy Husk: detonated by Sergeant Vane's krak charge, unmasking the True Matriarch sleeping below

sump_sewer_scuttlers.name: Sump Sewer-Scuttlers
notable_kills: Alpha Brood-Scuttler: bisected by Sergeant Kathryn Vane's Chainsword Mk. VII
4 Heavy Armored Scuttlers: skull-pulped by Bone 'ead Bragg's Power Fist
Drainage Swarm (37 scuttlers): concentrated lasfire and Trooper Jax's 2 frag canisters

feral_sump_stalkers.name: Feral Sump Stalkers
notable_kills: 5 forward mutant scouts picked off by Bastion Heavy Stubber overwatch during welding phase

sub_units.armament: Kantrael Lasguns, combat knives, scarred flak vests
sub_units.station: Hab-Block Vermis-9 & Charnel Trench rim (2 conscripts dissolved by acid blast)

krak_grenades.unit: charges (CRITICAL: Required to crack boss armor)

active_resource_stockpile.quarantine_logistics_alert: CRITICAL COMBAT ALERT: Bio-Titanic apex threat engaged in Charnel Ditches. Armor-cracking weapons and heavy overwatch required immediately.

new_decision.decision: Challenged the Emperor for an apex trial: discovered the destroyed beast was merely a larval decoy as the true 20-ton Brood-Matriarch erupted from the slime lake, blasting the trench with caustic bile.
new_decision.impact: Sustained 15 damage from shockwave and shrapnel; locked in life-or-death confrontation with a 450 HP Bio-Titan.

new_decision.decision: Threw his colossal body in front of Sergeant Vane to take the brunt of Gorgon-Prime's acid vomit; carapace armor melted and flesh blistered.
new_decision.impact: Sustained heavy 25 damage (Vitality 120 -> 95), barely remaining on his feet.

new_decision.decision: Blasted backward into the catwalk railings by the beast's tail-lash, screaming as two conscripts beside him were dissolved into slurry.
new_decision.impact: Pinned under iron girders, lasgun power cell sparking in the mud.
